Right vignette reads weak: three stacked coin circles don't convey "pouring into" the box, and the datacenter isn't glowing — add a short raw drip/stream shape linking coins to the box and give the box a glow highlight so the no-payoff gag lands as fast as the classroom gag.

Fails on clarity/composition/polish.
